[NDBG.14w.1a] `schema` filters to one schema type. Omit for all
schemas. `where` is an optional DS expression pattern-filter using
the same syntax as a rule `where` clause, compiled with the compiler; the
fact is named by its schema name lower-cased (`sensor` for `Sensor`). `where`
requires `schema` — it is an error to supply `where` without `schema`.

Response:
```json
{
  "facts": [
    { "fact_id": "#42",
      "schema": "Sensor",
      "slots": { "entity_id": "kitchen_temp", "value": 95.2 },
      "logical": true,
      "ttl_remaining_ns": null }
  ],
  "total": 3
}
```
